move: tilted colour stripes conveyor one way, thin dark stripes race the other
how: A 2400px square sheet rotated -24deg holds two layers: wide 64px bands on a 96px pitch cycling orange, cream and yellow, and thin 10px near-black stripes on a 48px pitch. Layer one translates y by -8 pitches and layer two by +20 pitches over D with ease none, so both tile seamlessly and appear to flow in opposite directions. The whole sheet leans from -24 to -18deg and scales 1 to 1.08 in one sine yoyo cycle, and the wide bands pulse scaleY 1 to 0.72 in a staggered wave (0.035s each) down the sheet. A radial vignette darkens the corners.
adapt: Change the three band colours and the background, the tilt angle and band pitch; fewer, fatter bands read as more graphic. Keep the integer-pitch travel distances so the scroll loops.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the rotated sheet and appends the band divs for both layers; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline: two linear y tweens over D, the yoyo lean/scale and the staggered scaleY pulse, with selectors scoped to el. The 2400px sheet assumes a 1280x720 frame; size it to cover the rotated shot.
caveats: the staggered scaleY pulse starts up to 1.1s late for the last bands so they are still mid-cycle at D; the loop does not close cleanly on band thickness
